tool_args.rationale: The evidence and causal guidance point to a history-conditioned coupled memory ODE. The five existing rows are insufficient to identify its four parameters reliably, so acquire the fine trajectory batch before fitting and confirming.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the coupled two-state memory ODE using the five existing rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The authorized mechanism has four fitted parameters and explicitly requires at least eight trajectories; five rows leave genuine identifiability ambiguity.
It does not supply the additional fine trajectories needed to identify the authorized four-parameter ODE.
It is unrelated to the identified trajectory-data gap and has avoidable cost.
